query: residential painting contractor in Port St. Lucie, FL
name: BP Wood & Painting, Corp.
owner: Marconi (named as owner by multiple Google reviewers; Carlos is named repeatedly as a crew member working alongside him)
address: 1571 SW Delos Ave, Port St. Lucie, FL 34953, United States
website_check_notes: Google Maps listing has no website field (shows 'Add website'), re-confirmed live via gmaps_detail.js at build time. A Birdeye aggregator profile (reviews.birdeye.com/bp-wood-painting-corp-167014491165138, itself just a reputation-management mirror, not the business' own site) lists 'http://bpwoodandpainting.com/' as the website, so that domain was checked directly: DNS resolves (Google Cloud DNS, ns-cloud-a1.googledomains.com), it has a valid TLS cert issued to bpwoodandpainting.com, but every path (/, /index.html, www. subdomain) returns Google's generic infrastructure 404 page ('That's an error', Google robot image), with no MX or TXT records either. The domain is registered but has no site deployed to it, the equivalent of a parked/unpublished domain, so it does not count as an owned, functioning website. A lantern.llc booking-platform page (lantern.llc/b/bp-wood-painting-corp-port-st-lucie/book, a hosted booking subdomain, not an owned domain even if live) was also checked directly and returns its own 404 (NOT_FOUND), so it is dead as well. No Facebook or Instagram page was found for the business.
social_search_notes: WebSearch for 'BP Wood & Painting Port St Lucie Facebook', 'Instagram Marconi', and the business name alone returned only contractor directory/aggregator listings (Birdeye, Lantern, BlueBook, Thumbtack, Houzz, Angi, BBB, HomeAdvisor) and competitor painters in the same city, no Facebook or Instagram profile for this business.
email_search_notes: No email found. Checked: Google Maps listing (none published), the Birdeye aggregator profile (explicitly states no business email, only a 'Call us' link; the profile is unclaimed by the owner), the dead lantern.llc booking page (404, no content), WebSearch for 'BP Wood Painting Port St Lucie email contact' (no result), and the bpwoodandpainting.com domain (no MX/TXT records, confirming no email hosting is configured there). No Facebook/Instagram About section exists to check since no social profile was found.
niche: residential painting contractor (interior/exterior painting, drywall repair, molding/baseboard installation, color consultation)
services_source_note: Service list compiled from Google Maps' own 'serviceMentions' extraction on the live listing (molding, baseboard installation, house painting, color consultation, crown molding all tagged with review counts) plus verbatim Google reviews and the Birdeye aggregator's review summaries, which add drywall repair, power washing, deck painting and exterior wood siding repair. No price list exists anywhere (expected for this niche); the site uses 'Quote on request' throughout per PIPELINE Fase 3 point 5.

photos_rejected: A stacked-stone TV accent wall (unrelated to painting/trim work, stonework not paint, excluded from gallery).
A white kitchen with granite counters and black appliances (too generic/unrelated to demonstrate painting or trim craftsmanship specifically, excluded).
An exact duplicate of the navy-wall-with-pool-view photo returned twice by the photo scraper (deduped, only one copy used).
No selfies, portraits, process shots, or text-overlay images existed in the Maps photo set to begin with; all photos found were finished-room interior/exterior shots, which simplified curation.
photo_curation_note: gmaps_photocycle.js returned 11 unique photo URLs (one was an exact duplicate, leaving 10 distinct images); all were downloaded and visually reviewed one by one (Read tool) before selection. 8 of the 10 were real, high-quality, finished painting/trim work (navy accent walls, shiplap, crown molding, wainscoting, painted doors, exterior curb appeal) and were used across hero, About and the gallery grid. 2 (stone TV wall, generic kitchen) were visually fine but not relevant to demonstrating painting/trim craftsmanship and were left out rather than used as filler, per the 'fewer good photos beats filling with weak ones' rule. No crew, van or branding photos existed in the available set; Facebook/Instagram were searched for additional media but no profile exists for this business, so no further photos were available.

reviewSamples.author: Alan Meister
reviewSamples.text: We are very happy with our overall experience and the work done. We received a timely call back on initial call, Marconi called back exactly when he said he would and was exactly on time for our agreed appointment for an estimate.

reviewSamples.author: B B
reviewSamples.text: Marconi & Carlos finished painting the exterior of my home and WOW does it look beautiful! They are punctual, meticulous, knowledgeable and trustworthy professionals.

reviewSamples.author: Dwight Jordan
reviewSamples.text: We can't say enough about this company. He was the 1st person to give us an estimate, and after several estimates he was the one we went with. He had a 5 star rating and we see why.

reviewSamples.author: J R
reviewSamples.text: Marconi & Carlos are the absolute best at their craft. They are professional, experienced, knowledgeable, considerate, and most importantly great people. They completed both interior and exterior painting, drywall repair and power washing.

reviewSamples.author: Andrea Perurena
reviewSamples.text: Thank You Marconi and team for your awesome work!! They are very professional, neat, clean, fast and hard workers. They helped me choose the colors for the exterior paint for my house and the results came out spectacular.

This build at output/bp-wood-painting-port-st-lucie/ is the complete, correct one per the current SKELETONS-V2 method; the orchestrator may want to delete the stale duplicate directory.
brand_vibe: No logo or branding exists for this business anywhere found (no website, no social media). The business' own Google Maps photos consistently show a deep navy-blue accent wall paired with crisp white wainscoting/crown molding trim across two different rooms, which reads as a sophisticated, trustworthy 'craftsman premium' palette distinct from existing site palettes (coral, caramelo, esmeralda, teal, violeta). Built on the light-v2 skeleton with the plum-pink palette replaced by a full deep-navy family (#1d3557 / #3f6ea5) on a warm cream base (#faf7f1 / #eee7d8), directly derived from what the business' own real photos show, with the gold Merktop badge left untouched. A text monogram ('BP') was used in place of a logo image since none exists.
